time_based_recommendations.morning: Limit strenuous activity; wear a high-filtration mask if pollution is visible.
time_based_recommendations.afternoon: Seek air-conditioned indoor environments. Avoid direct sun exposure and heavy exertion.
time_based_recommendations.evening: Focus on hydration and gentle movement. Consider an antihistamine if pollen symptoms are present.
time_based_recommendations.night: Keep windows closed during peak pollution hours; use HEPA filtration indoors.

preventative_recommendations: Prioritize hydration: Drink water consistently, regardless of thirst.
Limit outdoor activity to early morning (before 9 AM) or late evening (after 6 PM).
If pollution is visible, wear an N95 or KN95 mask when outdoors.
Keep medication (antihistamines, inhalers) readily accessible and follow prescribed regimens.
Avoid strenuous exercise during the peak heat hours (10 AM - 4 PM).
